svg.title: Benchmark framework domain model
svg.desc: A structural diagram showing the core resources (Scenario, Target, Workload, Driver, Collector) and their relationship to pluggable providers, a Run State Store (phase status and infra outputs), and a shared expanded lifecycle.

g.text: async remote: orchestrator provisions → driver downloads benchctl → benchctl resume
run state is the handoff mechanism · teardown is decoupled
